# taste fixture — a real mount's shape, invented content

**No listener data is in this directory** (user decision, 2026-09-20). Every
title, artist and playlist name here is made up, and none of them names a
real song, artist or release. There are no urls: a playable `ref` carries
account-reachable ids, so the rows have none.

What the digest's budget tests need from a real mount is its *shape* — how
many rows of each kind each platform returns, and a spread of title lengths
wide enough that the 1500-character budget is genuinely under pressure. A
handful of hand-written rows never is, and every budget bug spec 14 §2.3
records was found only at full size: 200 watched rows, 186 liked, 50
playlists, 100 subscriptions. Those counts are what this fixture reproduces.

The YouTube and Bilibili rows are plain `<kind> row <n>`: those rows must
never reach the block (§2.3's invariant), so the tests only need them to
exist in the right kind and count.

Generated by `scratch/make-fixture.py`, which is not committed (`scratch/` is
gitignored). It reads nothing — the counts are hardcoded in it and the
strings are drawn from word pools under a fixed seed, so it reproduces this
directory byte for byte.
